Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 144. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 35 ki
Prerequisites: 1 Star in Instant Galick Gun
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: self (180 foot line)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Beam
Charges one of the strongest variants of the Galick
Gun.
Targets in this 5 ft wide, 180 foot long line must make
a dexterity saving throw dealing 8d6 damage on a fail,
half on a success.
